events.cap: srun starts one task per node. On node 0 (c1) the task execs torchrun, which starts by importing torch.
Node 1 (c2) starts its torchrun too, at almost the same moment.
Node 0's agent has imported torch. Its host name matches the endpoint c1:29500, so it starts the rendezvous store there and adds itself to the participant list: 1 of 2.
Node 0 waits, re-reading the shared state about once a second (the rendezvous polls with a 1 s delay).
Node 1's agent connects to c1:29500 as a client and joins: 2 of 2 = --nnodes, so the round is complete (0.89 s after node 1 asked).

Both agents know the result: node ranks 0 and 1, world size 4. The agent that is node rank 0 starts a second store, for the workers, on a free port (here 34161) and publishes it as MASTER_ADDR/MASTER_PORT.
The workers' store is up on node 0.
Each agent spawns its 2 workers; all 4 processes start within 0 ms and import torch and train.py.

1.12 s later the imports are done and each rank calls init_process_group: it connects to the workers' store as a client (TORCHELASTIC_USE_AGENT_STORE=True) and posts its gloo address. All 4 within 5 ms.
Each rank reads the other three addresses and connects to them (gloo's full mesh): process group ready. Slowest rank: 11 ms inside init_process_group.
Data, model and the DDP wrapper (which broadcasts rank 0's weights), then the first step: done at 4.42 s after the first task started.

ok.note: Slurm run 1 of section 3, every time from the probes. The rendezvous store and the workers' store both live inside node 0's torchrun process.

events.cap: srun starts the task on both nodes. Node 0's task execs torchrun; node 1's task runs sleep 100000 instead (the knob LA_POD1): its torchrun never starts.
Node 0's agent starts the rendezvous store on c1:29500 and joins: 1 of 2.
Node 0 waits. Nothing is printed: no warning, no progress line. The job looks RUNNING in squeue, holding 2 nodes and 4 GPUs.
Five minutes in: still waiting, still silent. The only clue is what is missing: node 1 never logged anything.
The 600 s join deadline passes. torchrun raises RendezvousTimeoutError (with an empty message) and exits 1; srun kills node 1's task.

miss.note: Slurm missing-node run of section 7: node 0's real timestamps; node 1 never starts torchrun.
